programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Pascal will visit Algeria - a culinary melting pot born from the combination of Berber, Bedouin and French cuisine.The journey begins in Algiers, where he learns about local delicacies and goes shopping at the oldest market in the capital.Use them to make an eggplant and meat apple pie.In the evening, in a confectionery shop with sweets, he learns what their secret is.Pascal's next stop is Bou Sada.The cook, together with Rashid and his family, prepares a traditional snack - sveti.Then he goes to the largest dromedary farm to learn the secret of camel milk.

programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Pascal continues his journey through Algeria.In Tipaza he goes out to sea to collect nets.Then, grilled fish with vegetable sauce is prepared on the shore in the company of a crowd of passers-by.Then Pascal finds the oldest shop selling dates and finds out why they are so popular.The cook is invited to a spontaneous party with local decision-makers and journalists.Unfortunately, the next day Pascal has an accident, tears his ankle ligament and damages the joint capsule.However, he does not give up and returns to cooking the next day.Pea soup with spices is made in a palm grove.And for dessert, thousand-hole pancakes with date jam.

programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Cameras visit the clove plantations for which Zanzibar is famous.Viewers will discover how they are grown, harvested and dried, as well as how the best spices are selected.The cook Habiba will reveal the secrets of traditional dishes of this country, and at the same time Pascal will find out what the women of Zanzibar think about men who get involved in cooking.A healer from a friendly village will tell the host about the healing properties of cloves.Finally, Pascal will show you how to combine colorful African cuisine with Polish flavors and prepare a simple chicken curry in coconut milk.He will also explain why he loves one-pot meals.
